# RGB Glitch

**Distortion › Glitch** · v1.0.0 · 16 frames at 30 fps (6–36)

The picture tears into shifted colour channels and displaced blocks, and the new scene glitches in.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/rgb-glitch@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Tech, gaming and cyber looks
- Beat drops
- Something going wrong

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import rgbGlitch from './transitions/06-distortion/glitch/rgb-glitch';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(rgbGlitch, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 16 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | number | `1` | 0–3 | Overall glitch strength. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
